result.stdout:
Command Line Batch FileCreator (clbfc)
Version: 1.12.2

Usage:
  bfc -c -fi <input1> [input2 ...] <outputdir> [--lang xx]
  bfc -c -fi
  bfc -c -fs <maskfile> [outputdir] [--lang xx]

Modes:
  -c                Create mode (required)
  -fi               Use to paste multiline Folderstructures into fiMode
  -fi -o            Open a .mask or any file in fiMode
  -fs               Create structure from a mask/script file

Options:
  --lang xx         Force language (for example: en, de, tr, sa, zh)
  -version          Show version
  -h, --help, -?, /? Show this help

  bfc -c -fi file1.txt folder1 output
  bfc -c -fs structure.mask output --lang de
